title: Urgent tab on Support tickets
problem: Urgent tickets were mixed in with everything else in the list.
now: An Urgent tab lists the open tickets marked Urgent, with its count.

steps.eval: (async () => { for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) { const b = document.querySelector('.mn-x'); if (!b) break; b.click(); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 300)); } })()
